response: GAMA-Bench’s eight classic game-theory scenarios are: 1) Guess 2/3 of the Average, 2) El Farol Bar, 3) Divide the Dollar, 4) Public Goods Game, 5) Diner’s Dilemma, 6) Sealed-Bid Auction (First-Price and Second-Price), 7) Battle Royale, and 8) Pirate Game. The authors group them into three categories: Cooperative Games (1–3), Betraying Games (4–6), and Sequential Games (7–8).
judge_justification: The response correctly lists all eight scenarios and groups them into the same three categories as the reference answer. The only extra detail is the parenthetical clarification for Sealed-Bid Auction, which does not affect correctness.
